scenes.headline: Where Ling-3.1-flash keeps its bytes
scenes.sub: A hybrid-attention mixture of experts, counted from its files
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Marrow! Ling-3.1-flash is a huge open model from inclusionAI. I read every tensor header in its files. Here's how it's built.

scenes.text: Seven of every eight attention layers keep a fixed-size memory, and the experts that hold most of the bytes drop to four bits.
scenes.say: The idea: seven of every eight attention layers keep a fixed-size memory. And the experts, which hold almost all the bytes, drop to four bits.

steps.say: A token climbs nine groups: seven linear attention layers, then one full attention layer.

steps.note: a fixed state per head, any length
steps.say: The seven are Kimi Delta Attention. Each head keeps a small state and rewrites it every token, so it never grows.
The eighth is gated latent attention, with a compressed cache of every token for exact recall.
Then a router picks eight of five hundred twelve experts, plus one shared expert.
On top, one extra layer drafts tokens ahead.
The released checkpoint is eight-bit, and almost all of it is routed experts.
Store each expert weight in four bits, one shared scale per block of thirty-two.
Attention and the shared parts stay eight-bit. Every token uses them.
The totals match the launch thread exactly, read as gibibytes.

scenes.title: Smaller file, fewer reads?
scenes.note: full-rank KDA gates are half of each token's weights
scenes.say: But a smaller file is not a faster token. A decode step reads only eight experts, and the big attention weights every time. Reads fall by about a sixth.

scenes.label: left per H100 for cache, four GPUs, four-bit experts
scenes.say: On four H100 cards, the four-bit build loads with about one gibibyte to spare per card. Four H200 cards have room.

left.title: The launch claims
left.say: The launch says a million tokens.

right.title: The shipped config
items: Position only in the 9 MLA layers
right.say: The open config stops near two hundred sixty thousand positions. Plan for that.

scenes.text: Four-bit experts nearly halve the file; the attention layers decide what each token costs.
scenes.say: Four-bit experts nearly halve the file. The attention layers decide what each token costs.
Seven linear layers to one exact layer. Experts are the bytes. Attention is the reads.
